title: Flocculation
description: A pinch of a salt like alum makes the fine particles clouding muddy water clump into flakes that sink, leaving it clear. Schulze showed the salt's charge decides how little is needed. Every water works does this.
effect: a salt makes fine suspended particles clump and sink
pickWhy: Borderline on the date: alum has cleared water since antiquity; I dated it to when the effect was explained.
edbDesc: A process of contact and adhesion whereby the particles of a dispersion form larger-size clusters.
